dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structure in the lower-left quadrant shows a sharp, high-contrast white perimeter with a steep gradient transition to a dark core. Central 'C' and 'O' clusters exhibit irregular, fragmented white boundaries that transition abruptly to dark interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters is present, specifically a large diffuse patch in the upper-left corner and smaller, more concentrated light-pixel blobs interspersed between the ring structures in the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the lower-left annulus, the mid-left irregular ring, and the central cluster form a wide scalene triangle. Smaller secondary nodes form a loose linear chain following the dorsal-lateral curve.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific 'chaining' effect where multiple macro-annuli perimeters overlap or intersect in the central lateral region, creating a continuous network of high-contrast edges.
